content.title: Validate: regenerate fix in open auth mode
content.description: Validate the fix end-to-end: POST /api/users/:name/regenerate returns 201 with a new token in open auth mode. Run the full webapp e2e suite (phase4-validation.spec.ts now asserts success). Confirm no regressions in register/revoke routes. Confirm the 'Can regenerate a token' acceptance criterion (Phase 4) is fully met.
